# Local OCR Assets

These files provide offline, browser-side optical character recognition for the Laboratory Staff result scanner.

- `tesseract.js` 7.0.0 — Apache-2.0
- `tesseract.js-core` 7.0.0 — Apache-2.0
- English trained data from `@tesseract.js-data/eng` 1.0.0 — MIT

The scanner processes selected images in the user's browser. The source image is only sent to this clinic application's API when the Laboratory Staff user submits it as part of the result record.

Upstream projects:

- https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
- https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
